summary: Soulpower Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting a Second Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with SWB Holdings (Pubco) and SWB LLC. The amendment revises the Uruguay Contribution Agreement treatment, adjusting post-closing contribution for $5M cash plus earnout shares, clarifies the Merger Consideration formula by allocating Carident AG put-option shares separately, and revises Company Net Asset Amount definitions. The Outside Date extends to April 2, 2027. No specific price per share, premium, or advisors are stated. This is a routine amendment to an existing de-SPAC agreement, not a new special situation; the original combination remains pending, and the extended deadline is the key watch item.
